dedupe_keys.name: times sweden industry database techno economic data for industrial technologies subres

description: This database holds techno-economic data for industrial technologies compiled from the literature and formatted for TIMES energy system models. The Zenodo record says it was developed for TIMES-Sweden but can be applied to other regions, is updated as the TIMES-Sweden work progresses and is part of the IEA-ETSAP SubRES effort to make techno-economic data easier to access. It was published on 27 October 2020 (version 0.1.0) by Erik Sandberg of Luleå University of Technology as two Excel SubRES workbooks for new industrial technologies (about 70 KB and 160 KB) and a version note, free to download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Swedish industry. Caveats: it is an early version (0.1.0), values are literature-based, and the workbook layout targets TIMES users. For simulation it gives costs, efficiencies and lifetimes of industrial technologies for energy system optimisation of industrial decarbonisation and fuel switching. Related catalogue records include the TIMES-Sweden databases for heat generation and fuel production technologies and the TUD Industrial Database.
